description: Lead ownership decisions for the design-system debt ledger builder (scripts/design-system/ledger-build.mjs, loaded by loadDecisions()). Each decision assigns an owner and a repair checkpoint to fingerprints that would otherwise be unresolved — a path with no lane in design-system/surfaces.json, or no matching entry in RULE_CHECKPOINT. Decisions are tried in array order; the first match wins. A path already resolved by lane ownership or classified as a runtime extension-boundary rule never reaches this list. Schema per decision: name (string, required) human-readable label used in reporting and in the ledger entry's "owner" string; type (string, required) one of "catalogClassification" | "exactPaths"; checkpoint (string, required) one of ledger.schema.json's expiryCheckpoint enum (A, B, C1, C2, C3, C4, C5, C6) — the repair batch this decision's entries are due in; owner (string, required) ownership label — a matched ledger entry's "owner" field is "<checkpoint> <owner>"; classifications (string array, required when type=catalogClassification) matches a finding when design-system/catalog.json has an entry for the finding's path whose "classification" field is one of these values; paths (string array, required when type=exactPaths) matches a finding when its path is exactly one of these repo-relative paths.
